connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.midasprotocol.org over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
